pattern: filter two periods and groups, derive two percentages
question: for Gaya and Nalanda in 2022 and 2023 give two percentages: institutional deliveries and 48 hour checks over registrations
gold_sql: SELECT district, year, ROUND(100.0 * institutional_deliveries / pregnancies_registered, 1) AS delivery_percent, ROUND(100.0 * postnatal_check_48h / pregnancies_registered, 1) AS postnatal_percent FROM maternal_services WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2022, 2023) ORDER BY district, year
sql_duckdb: SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN institutional_deliveries ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 100 AS "institutional_deliveries_2022", (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN postnatal_check_48h ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 100 AS "48 hour checks over registrations_2022", (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN institutional_deliveries ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 100 AS "institutional_deliveries_2023", (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN postnatal_check_48h ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 100 AS "48 hour checks over registrations_2023" FROM maternal_services WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
